title: Transfers
description: Vehicle transfers between branches: planned, in transit and completed moves.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view transfers.
empty_description: Plan a transfer to move a vehicle to another branch.
no_access_description: Viewing transfers needs the read transfers permission.
fields.from_branch_hint: A vehicle is never at another branch by itself: it leaves from where it is at the planned departure.
fields.arrival_status_hint: Choose preparing when the vehicle needs a check first.
dialog.title: Plan a transfer
dialog.description: The planned window cannot overlap another transfer or a block of the vehicle.
dialog.started_description: Only the cost and the note of a started transfer can change.
action_dialog.start_description: {{plate}} leaves {{from}} for {{to}}; the vehicle status becomes in transfer.
action_dialog.complete_description: {{plate}} arrived at {{to}}; the vehicle's current branch is updated.
action_dialog.cancel_description: The {{from}} → {{to}} transfer of {{plate}} is cancelled; a vehicle on the road stays at {{from}}, available.
validation.arrival_after_departure: The arrival must be after the departure.
validation.same_branch: The destination must differ from the origin.
validation.cost: Enter a valid amount (at most 2 decimals).
